t: A camera equipped programmable drone with object detection for older students.
steps: Contact Robolink to confirm that the CoDrone EDU Plus is available for purchase.
Ask Robolink for the final price and the list of supported computers.
Find the Python library on PyPI and read its documentation.
Ask IT to install the library on one teacher computer.
Test a short flight in an open space with a teacher at the controls.
Try one camera feature, such as object detection, and check the results.
Review what the camera records before students use the drone.
